name: UNE Commonwealth Accommodation Scholarship
summary: Accommodation support for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students in financial need who relocate to study at UNE.
key: Up to $10,800 (paid pro-rata for part-time and fast-track study).
who: Identifies as an Australian Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person
Able to show a planned relocation for the upcoming teaching period
how: Complete the application form, including the Financial Need Details section; one application covers multiple scholarships
catches: Open until Commonwealth funds are exhausted, and may be first-come, first-served

source.label: University of New England: Commonwealth Accommodation Scholarship
